name: birthday_retro_pixel_site
description: Updated design: - Cleaner premium retro-gamer UI - Multiple full-screen sections with navigation - Space War arcade mini-game - Cake section revealed as you scroll into it - Custom knife cursor when hovering the cake - Click/tap the cake to trigger the cut animation - Synthesized retro Happy Birthday melody after the cut - Confetti and secret message finale - Responsive mobile layout - Easy text customization in `script.js`
